raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 12 (business date 2026-01-16) was ingested twice, at 02:00 and again at 05:00 on 2026-01-17. That gives 668 rows, about twice normal volume, and 334 duplicated txn_ids, of which 317 are POSTED. The copies in the sample are exact duplicates, so silver_transactions and every gold table derived from it double-count 2026-01-16. Fix: deduplicate raw_transactions on txn_id, keeping the latest ingested copy, before applying the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": ["CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dedup_transactions AS SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1"], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
